input:
learner text: 一个男生和一只驴从农人经过了。
quote: 一个男生和一只驴从农人经过了
part p0: fix [ref p0/k0] 一个男人牵着一只驴从农民身边经过 ; notes: “跟/和+noun.” is used for multiple nouns that have the same action, we can say: 一个男生和一个女生走……，because both 男生and 女生 “walk”, but here “驴” does not walk by itself, but walked by 男生, so you need to use the accompanying phrase “V.着”
part p1: comment [ref p1/note] 从 + place，农民is not a place, 农民身边 is a place
part p2: comment [ref p2/note] the  word “经过” implies ongoing process, so no了(completed).

edits.reason: uses 男人 in the teacher's rewrite

edits.note: “跟/和+noun.” is used for multiple nouns that have the same action, we can say: 一个男生和一个女生走……，because both 男生and 女生 “walk”, but here “驴” does not walk by itself, but walked by 男生, so you need to use the accompanying phrase “V.着”
edits.reason: replaces coordination with the accompanying-action phrase
uses the location phrase in the teacher's rewrite
